trello.name: Document security incident attempt
trello.desc: Hassan to document the injection attempt including the raw ticket, summarizer output behavior, timestamps, and file it in the security log with a severity assessment by the end of this week.

trello.name: Harden ticket pipeline and add regression tests
trello.desc: Wren to add a sanitization layer in the ticket parser with delimiters and an instruction-pattern filter to neutralize injection attempts. This includes converting the specific attack ticket into a test fixture that verifies the summary stays clean, and adding an eval that runs a suite of injection attempts against the summarizer on every deploy.

trello.name: Investigate password reset delivery for user jdoe443
trello.desc: Wren to check reset email delivery logs for the last week and follow up on the user account. If resets are broken, escalate to a separate incident; if it is a burner account, close it.

trello.name: Provide list of new service accounts for quarterly access review
trello.desc: Hassan to provide Grace with the list of service accounts created since May by Thursday, ahead of the quarterly access review due Friday.
